notes: Reconciliation: cross-verse consistency. PSA.17.1 headed the light-verb expression 'Give ear unto' on 'Give' while PSA.17.7 headed 'Show marvellous' on the lexeme-bearing 'marvellous'; one chapter, two analyses of the same construction. Corrected to t015 'ear'. The corpus settles it: PSA.5.1 renders the same H238 imperative 'Give ear to' and heads 'ear', and the contract's own examples ('bear witness' -> 'witness', 'make straight' -> 'straight') are this construction. Rest of the verse re-checked and unchanged.
